## About
Blair's Auto Care is a family owned and operated shop on Stemmers Run Road in the heart of Essex, Maryland. Owner Martin (Mark) Blair is the lead technician and worked as a factory trained Master Technician before opening his own shop. Lisa is also there to take your call.
We work on most American and foreign cars and light trucks, and on commercial fleets too. Our ASE certified technicians handle brakes, engines, transmissions, electrical problems, inspections and a lot more. Mark has been taking things apart and putting them back together for as long as he can remember, so the shop also does custom restorations, fabrication and welding.
Customers give us a 4.6 rating across 132 Google reviews. If you're local and need a mechanic, give us a call.

## Services
- Maryland state inspections: We are a registered Maryland state inspection facility.
- Oil changes: Stop by for your scheduled oil change.
- Brake service and repairs: Brake service and repair work.
- Transmission and clutch work: Transmission and clutch replacement, with your car back in a reasonable amount of time, according to one reviewer.
- Steering and suspension: Steering and suspension service.
- Electrical diagnosis and repair: For the electrical problem you can't track down.
- Air conditioning service and repairs: A/C service and repair to keep you comfortable.
- Fleet maintenance: Service, maintenance and repair for commercial vehicle fleets.
- Custom restorations, fabrication and welding: Custom auto restorations, custom fabrication projects and welding services.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Most American and foreign vehicles, including Chevy, Chrysler, Ford, Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Lexus and light trucks.

Q: How do I get home while my car is being repaired?
A: We offer a local shuttle service. We can take you home or to work and pick you up once the repairs are done.

Q: Are you a Maryland state inspection station?
A: Yes. We are Maryland State Inspection Station 7324-A.

Q: Is there a fee for paying by credit card?
A: Yes. Credit card transactions have a 3% processing fee.
